steps.content: You alter the course of the submarine just in time, giving Pylgia a quick confirm through the radio.

The injured monster's growls draw nearer, yet there's little you can do. All that remains is to trust in Pylgia's guidance and pray that the impaired submarine can carry you to safety before the monster catches up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not good... Looks like he's been possessed by something...
He seems trapped in some terrible nightmare. His eyes are shut tight, his face alternating between terror and eerie grins as he mumbles incomprehensible words.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Dr. Banyan will cure him. I'm sure...
